title: Two people, Times Square, one umbrella

turns.text: These two are a couple. Show them together in Times Square at night, exactly the view in the third photo, sharing one umbrella and laughing. Keep both faces. 16:9.

tests: Two identities plus a place: does each face survive, and are both people present?

answer_sheet.Who: The woman in the first photo and the man in the second.
answer_sheet.Where: Times Square as in the third photo.

must_haves: Both people are present: a woman with long light-brown hair matching the first photo and a man with a short beard matching the second.
They share one umbrella and are laughing.
The background is Times Square at night with its lit billboards, as in the attached photo.
